record: Row-level integrity audit (corrected 4v4 entity-repair specialist crossover, 18300001-18300128)
raised_by: eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py's own built-in tie/reversal check. Wrote CONFIRMATORY_B3_ENTITY_REPAIR_CORRECTED_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_EVAL_INTEGRITY_REQUIRED.json and refused to write a verdict-bearing result, exactly as designed.
context: this is the FIRST valid crossover for a pi_B3 that actually trained against the certified Pole B (SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1, attested: certified hash == live hash). It replaces the CONFIRMATORY_B3_ENTITY_REPAIR run (seed block 17800001-17800128), which is invalid: that pi_B3 trained against canonical OP7. See PI_B3_TRAIN_EVAL_POLE_MISMATCH_INVALIDATION.json.
per_cell_integrity: all 4 cells independently checked: exactly 128 rows each, seeds unique, seed set EXACTLY {18300001..18300128}, win values strictly binary. Win-flag vs (blue>red) checked against all 512 rows: 0 disagreements.
seed_pairing: confirmed identical 128 seed keys present across all 4 cells -- paired design intact.

split_half_check.purpose: confirm each delta's sign and magnitude are a distributed effect across the seed block, not a subset artifact.
split_half_check.reading: delta_B is IDENTICAL to four decimal places in both halves. delta_A is positive and large in both halves. Neither effect is a batch-boundary artifact -- both are stable across the entire seed block.

bootstrap_recomputation.method: independently recomputed from the raw per-episode rows CSV with fresh code, same frozen protocol (paired percentile bootstrap, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7)
bootstrap_recomputation.note: delta_B's ENTIRE interval is negative (ucb95 = -0.0469 < 0). This IS a decisive reversal, unlike the invalid run's delta_B = -0.086 [-0.195, +0.023], whose interval straddled zero. With the confound removed, the negative effect did not shrink to inconclusive -- it sharpened into a confirmed one.

classification: GENUINE, DECISIVE. Rows are structurally clean (seeds unique 512/512, exact ranges, zero win/margin disagreements, delta_B bit-identical across both seed-block halves). Not a duplicate-seed artifact, not a corrupted row, not a pairing bug.
interpretation_licensed_by_this_audit: with a properly trained pi_B3 (attested against the certified Pole B), delta_A_spec passes cleanly and delta_B_spec is a CONFIRMED reversal, not an inconclusive null. pi_A3 beats Pole B at 0.7422 -- HIGHER than pi_B3_corrected's own 0.5859 on the pole it was specifically trained for. This is the pattern already seen once before in this project (EXPLORATORY_4V4_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER, delta_B=-0.3047, fully negative interval): one policy performing strongly against BOTH poles while the other underperforms even on its own, consistent with pi_A3 having converged toward a strong generalist rather than the two developing complementary, mutually-exclusive specializations.

PRIMARY_GATE.joint_gate: FAIL -- requires both to pass; only delta_A did

note_on_seed_matching: pi_A3 (training seed 17700001) and pi_B3_corrected (training seed 18200001) are NOT matched-seed treatments -- the corrected retrain required a fresh seed after the construct-validity failure. This adds a training-seed nuisance term to the comparison; it does not explain a decisive, fully-negative interval of this size.
